children: GE announced an $11.75 billion agreement to acquire Consolidated Precision Products to expand mission-critical castings capacity.
GE will acquire CPP for $11.75B in cash, subject to closing adjustments and customary conditions.
Transaction expected to close in the second half of 2027 and is subject to regulatory approvals.
Deal financed with existing cash ($7B) and new debt; no change to GE’s capital allocation plans.
GE projects adjusted EPS and free cash flow accretion in year 1 and ~18x 2027 EBITDA including synergies.
CPP brings ~6,600 employees, >20 facilities, ~ $2.0B 2027E revenue and customer relationships across commercial and defense.
This is an AI-powered summary. It may contain inaccuracies. Consider verifying important information with the source. Please note this summary is solely based on documents filed with the SEC.

title: GE to buy Consolidated Precision Products for $11.75B, deal expected to close H2 2027
